title: ZPA Private Service Edge Release Summary (2022)

blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements released per Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) Private Service Edge version.
This ZPA Private Service Edge version includes the following updates:

blocks.item: An update was released to provide support for Platform as a policy criteria option for access policies, timeout policies, client forwarding policies, isolation policies, and inspection policies. To learn more, see Updates to Policy Criteria.

An update was released to provide support for multiple tenants when establishing Zscaler Tunnels (Z-Tunnels) between Zscaler Client Connector and a ZPA Public Service Edge or ZPA Private Service Edge. To learn more, see Zscaler Client Connector Support for Multiple Tenants.

blocks.text: Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see About ZPA Private Service Edge Software Upgrades.
An optional update was released for the ZPA Private Service Edge Manager software that improves the internal routing of the distribution of binaries. To learn more, see About the Manager Software.

An update was released to support upcoming functionality changes to provide ZPA Private Service Edge platform and host OS details in the Private Service Edge Status Diagnostics and the Service Edges page.

Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see About ZPA Private Service Edge Software Upgrades.
This ZPA Private Service Edge version includes the following updates:

blocks.item: An update was released to address an issue where two-hop scenarios caused Machine Tunnel termination when traffic went from ZPA Private Service Edges to ZPA Public Service Edges.
An update was released for ZPA Private Service Edges to allow correlation of journal logs between ZPA Private Service Edges and Zscaler Client Connector, Machine Tunnels, and App Connectors.

blocks.text: Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see About ZPA Private Service Edge Software Upgrades.
The ZPA Private Service Edge version includes the following updates:

blocks.item: A recommended update was released for the ZPA Private Service Edge Manager Software to address an OpenSSL vulnerability. To learn more, see About the Manager Software.
An update was released for ZPA Private Service Edges to support upcoming functionality changes for TCP Quick Acknowledgement to improve performance of applications that use specific protocols.
An update was released to address bandwidth utilization issues on ZPA Private Service Edges.

blocks.text: Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see About ZPA Private Service Edge Software Upgrades.

blocks.item: ZPA Private Service Edges now support Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) so you can measure performance in the cloud path for internal applications. To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard and About ZDX Web Probe Rate Limiting.
